canon.silhouette: an A - a wide planted base under a narrow hard-edged torso, nothing leaving the body outline, the bright caged inside the chest
canon.reads_as: an empty-handed figure planted wide, lit from a slot cut in its own chest

prompt.description: A bare-headed figure in a heavy segmented breastplate, standing planted with the feet wide apart and both hands empty and open at the sides. No helmet, no hat, no hood: cropped hair, blunt face, heavy brow. Set into the centre of the breastplate is a small square iron window, barred across, with fire burning behind the bars; thick metal frames it hard on all four sides and no fire escapes it. Narrow shoulders over a wide braced stance, short thick legs, bare forearms. Nothing is carried and nothing hangs off the body.
must_include: bare head, no helmet, no hat, no hood
both hands empty and open, nothing carried
small square barred fire window set into the centre of the breastplate
feet planted wide apart, wide base under narrow shoulders
clean unbroken body outline, nothing protruding
must_avoid: any held weapon, staff, lantern or banner
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
fire escaping the chest frame or licking past the armour
